test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Jaspreet deposited ₹58,550 at 20% annual interest rate compounded annually. What is the total amount (in ₹) Jaspreet will receive after 2 years ?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹58,550

Rate of Interest (r) = 20% per annum

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

A = 58,550 × (1 + 20/100)²

⇒ A = 58,550 × (1 + 0.2)²

⇒ A = 58,550 × (1.2)²

⇒ A = 58,550 × 1.44

⇒ A = 84,312

**∴ The total amount Jaspreet will receive after 2 years is ₹84,312. The correct answer is option (2).**
